svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make eight. Cut 220 mm lengths of 75 x 75 x 6 angle; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg: two 13 mm holes on the middle of the length (110 mm),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 35 and 62 mm above the underside of the flat leg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flat leg: two 18 mm holes 40 mm out from the back of the upright

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: leg, 30 mm in from each end (160 mm apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a pair together, clamped back to back, so the holes match.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one cleat each side of the post, upright legs flat on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: post's left and right faces (as seen from the street),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flat legs on the base plate. Two M12 bolts through cleat, post

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and cleat; the anchors go through the flat legs and the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with both cleats on, the four flat-leg holes line up with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the plate's holes and the post's holes with the upright legs.
